help.title: About Collections
help.overview: A collection is a merchandising group of products, such as "Summer sale" or "New arrivals", shown on the storefront and usable as a target for discounts and pricing rules. It is either manual (you pick the products) or dynamic (rules pick them).

sections.title: Manual or dynamic
sections.body: The type decides where membership comes from.
items: Manual: the collection contains exactly the products you add.
Dynamic: membership is computed live from rules, and only active products qualify. A dynamic collection with no rules contains nothing.
Match all requires every rule; match any requires at least one.

sections.title: Rules
sections.body: Each rule is a field, an operator, and a value.
items: Tag, brand, vendor, and product type support equals, not equals, contains, not contains, and starts with.
Category supports equals (or contains) and not equals (or not contains) against the product's categories.
Price supports equals, not equals, greater than, and less than.
Inventory level is accepted but not applied yet; a rule on it is ignored.

sections.title: Storefront and pricing
items: Activate and deactivate set whether the collection is visible on the storefront. A hidden collection is not listed or browsable, but still exists for discounts and pricing rules.
Discounts and pricing rules aimed at a collection use the same membership the storefront shows.
Name, description, main image, position, and SEO title and description shape the collection page.
Deleting is a soft delete and it can be restored.
